craft_notes: Sthāyin: utkrānti unit 25. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: In his ear, or should read again, again, or then should cause to read;
himself and rite should perform, tattva-purity-and-the-rest, the guru
l4.sanskrit_cite: karṇe@sya vā paṭhedbhūyo bhūyo vāpyatha pāṭhayet svayaṃ ca karma kurvīta tattvaśuddhyādikaṃ guruḥ
